items.detail: Still questionable as of 19:47Z and called a gametime decision: left corneal abrasion plus right-eye swelling from Wednesday's pokes; Udoka said 'we're not sure what that means time-wise,' and backup C Steven Adams is also questionable with Capela out.
Charlotte kept White on the bench through overtime Tuesday because of a minutes restriction; no report says it has been lifted for Friday, which caps his RA ceiling.
Upgraded to questionable (bilateral patellar tendinopathy) after missing six straight games; if he returns it trims frontcourt boards and touches for Zion and Saddiq Bey.
Questionable with a left hip sprain and in danger of missing a third straight game.
Added late to the report with an illness a few hours before tip; Nic Claxton and Zach Collins are the depth if he sits.

note: Evening run: no confirmed starting lineups published yet. Nets have no injuries (Randle, MPJ clear). No new news found on Peterson, Sabonis, Battle, Zubac, NAW or Zion beyond the brief.
